caption: The drawing depicts a framed picture hanging from a loop of cord at the top center. Inside the frame, there is a person with light skin, dark hair parted in the middle, and a red and green crown or halo on their head. The person is dressed in a long brown robe with light-colored cuffs and a striped collar. Their right hand is raised, holding a staff or cross with a double horizontal bar; the left hand is placed on the chest. To the left of the person, there is a simple, small skull on a red and brown surface. The background inside the frame is a plain off-white or light tan. To the right, there is a patterned curtain or drapery, with red, green, and brown shapes or spots on a light background, outlined in brown. The frame itself is outlined in dark brown with an inner red border. The objects are all contained within the frame, and the outer part of the drawing is a plain off-white with no additional objects or background details. The artist's name and location, "Marcel G. Clopton - Taos - N.M.," is printed in small letters in the bottom right corner.
title: Retablo-Santa Rita
